title: Set the rules
say: Open Rules. Lower the deny limit, add a tool that is never allowed, and save. The next decision follows the change; no restart, no tenant.

title: Try a request
say: On Try, send a transaction or an MCP tool call and read the verdict, the statements and PingOne's answer. A gate such as step-up is a permit plus a statement that names it.

title: Point a client at it
say: Connect shows the base URL and the mock worker credentials. A client gets a token, calls the decision endpoint and its call appears on Decisions marked API next to your own.

title: Start over
say: Reset session restores the default rules, clears the decision log and ends issued tokens. The worker credentials stay, so a client that has the secret still works.
